hints.content:
We can turn the rule into numbers and math symbols:

Rule: $\maroonD{\text{Multiply }} \blueD x \maroonD{\text{ by 0}}$.  Then $\greenD{\text{add 7}}$ to the result to get $\goldD y$.

$\blueD x \maroonD{\times 0} \greenD{+7} = \goldD y$

Now we can use the rule to  complete the  table: 

$x$ | |$y$ 
:-: | :-: 
$\blueD3$ |  $\blueD3 \maroonD{\times0}\greenD{+7} =  \goldD7$ | $\goldD7$
$\blueD5$ |  $\blueD5 \maroonD{\times0}\greenD{+7} =  \goldD7$  | $\goldD7$
$\blueD7$ | $\blueD7 \maroonD{\times0}\greenD{+7} =  \goldD7$ |$\goldD7$

Each pair of $x$ and $y$ values in the table represents an ordered pair and a point on the graph. 

The ordered pairs are:  $(3, 7), (5, 7),$ and $(7, 7)$.

Now let's graph each point.

Each $x$ value represents a number on the horizontal axis.

Each $y$ value represents a number on the vertical axis.

To graph the point $(\blueD3,\goldD7)$, go right on the $x$-axis $\blueD3$ spaces and up on the $y$-axis $\goldD7$ spaces.
